name: Rowan Roman
life: “I still remember rinsing a planter in the night staff sink.” On Wednesday, near the steps at Pier Beach, Rowan watches the working part of the waterfront before turning toward the open water.
voice: My partner and I argued about who kept it alive. The night cleaner brought us her watering diary.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a long navy raincoat and one cuff folded back twice. Rowan has an aquiline nose and a square chin, with a dark undercut with a longer wave on top. Rowan takes off the watch before a long conversation during a conversation.
personality: Rowan has excellent recall for voices and a poor memory for official titles. Someone who waited patiently at a counter years ago is more likely to be remembered than the person in charge.
agenda: To reconcile the two watering accounts with the cleaner's diary.
family: Roland Pierce is Rowan’s younger cousin. Rowan remembers the birthdays. Roland asks what the birthday guest would like this year. A present that was perfect at sixteen may be completely wrong at forty. They take the trouble of finding out. Asked about *The crash anniversary*, Roland says, “I wanted a mural until the survivor told me she would have to pass her face twice every day.”
connections: Sara Romero. The cleaner's diary settles what nearly killed the roots.
